climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Napa Valley AVA in the center of the valley, known for its Cabernet Sauvignon. Its well-drained soils mix gravel, loam and sand with volcanic deposits and marine sediments. It is home to historic wineries such as Beaulieu Vineyards and Inglenook.
